Hi team,

I completed your self-service sign-up for a Dedicated capacity demo yesterday and wanted to add a few notes about our workload so the demo can focus on the right things.

Company: CloudNorthridge, Inc.
Primary contact: Ari Chen (ari@cloudnorthridge.com)
Goal: Evaluate reserved GPU pools for a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline with ~150 QPS steady state and occasional bursts to 500 QPS for short windows.
Latency SLO: 99th percentile <= 250ms for short prompts (avg 70 tokens).
Average prompt length: 40–120 tokens, embedding calls for re-ranking in some flows.
Sensitive data: PII mixed in prompts (we will require VPC + KMS).

Would appreciate a 30–45 minute walkthrough that includes: throughput behavior, autoscale/burst policy options, and a quick look at how Redwood handles cache warmups.

Thanks,
